question: Does the ordinary Mellin affine filler descend naturally through basis mutation and Euler-cutoff completion?

answer.ordinary_affine_domain: yes, with all affine simplices admitted
answer.stokes_basis_mutation: yes at relative-class/period level; strict chain-representative action is not supplied
answer.finite_cutoff: yes through the adelic-height index, labelled chain functor, and finite Mellin evaluation
answer.completed_cutoff: yes conditionally on weighted source decay for each fixed reciprocal affine orbit strictly inside the decay strip

dependency_order: adelic cutoff index and labelled chain functor
excluded_promotions: period covariance to selected thimble chain
orbitwise completion to global spectral completion
conditional source decay to unconditional arithmetic theorem
